title: Core model, hashable score IR and recording-id grammar
context: Common Studio is an open, public-domain music production studio in software, written new in Python with permissive dependencies and released under the Unlicense. This task is part of its first milestones: the licence-clean spine that every later gate depends on. The owner's private reference pipeline may be consulted for ideas only; no text, configuration value, arrangement source, skill or asset from it may be copied, and every name, format and value is authored new.
objective: Implement the core model (Work, Arrangement identified as work--style, Part with notes on a beat grid plus lyrics, section count, voice and kit), a canonical deterministic hashable JSON score representation with round-trip conversion, and the recording-id grammar work--style[@venue][+treatment], as Python under src/ with pytest tests.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-01: Work, Arrangement, Part (notes as beat, pitch, duration, velocity, with optional lyrics, a section count, a voice and a kit) and the beat grid exist, and the recording ids work--style, work--style@venue, work--style+treatment and work--style@venue+treatment each parse and format, with unit tests passing in CI.

AC-02: toIR and fromIR round-trip on fixtures, the representation has deterministic key and note ordering, a one-note change changes the hash and an identical arrangement does not, with round-trip and hash tests passing in CI.
Nothing is copied from the private reference pipeline; every name, format and value is authored new.
Tests pass; the commit is DCO signed-off.
output: A pull request adding the core model, the score representation with hashing and round-trip tests, and the recording-id grammar under src/.
